record.question: Which of the following is correct regarding political involvement of family members of a Government servant?
options: Family members of a Government servant are prohibited from enrolling in any political party.
Family members may enroll in political parties, but they are prohibited from assisting any movement or activity that is subversive of the Government.
Prior sanction is required for family members to join any political party.
There is no prohibition on joining a political party, but prior sanction is required to contest in any election.
